system.description: Whenever you temporarily mend a Biotech device using the Treat Injury Skill, the mended device moves +4 steps on the Condition Track. In addition, the mended device only moves -3 steps down the Condition Track at the end of the scene or encounter, and is only disabled if this reduction brings it to -5 steps on the Condition Track.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
